c0: Redesign. Neutral and professional. Use it in strategy discussions and reports. Casual alternatives: rethink, or revamp.
c1: Reinvest. Formal business English. Use it in financial reports and board presentations. A more casual option: plow back.
c2: Streamline. Neutral and professional. Great for operations meetings and internal emails. Or simply say: simplify.
c3: Eliminate. Neutral to formal. Use it in strategy documents. Less formal: cut, or remove.
